images.title: Comparing two numbers place by place
images.purpose: Show two five-digit numbers one below the other on a chart, with the first place where the digits differ ringed.
images.composition: A two-row place value chart centred on white with the first differing place ringed and the comparison written on the right.
images.exact_structure: A table with header cells TTh, Th, H, T, O and two number rows. Row 1 digits: 5, 6, 3, 2, 1. Row 2 digits: 5, 6, 2, 9, 8. The TTh and Th cells of both rows have a thin #009E73 tick under them to show they match. The H cells of both rows (3 and 2) are ringed in #CC79A7. To the right of the table the line '56,321 > 56,298' is written large, with the word 'greater' under the first number.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Compare from the left and stop at the first place where the digits differ.
